item.title: You Will Not Transform Your Company With Use Cases
item.description:
Photo by Davit Magaltadze on Pexels.

Everyone has seen an impressive AI demo.

Almost nobody has seen an AI transformation.

Those are two very different things. Confusing them is one reason so many AI programs produce plenty of activity without changing how a company actually works.

You will not transform your company by building a few use cases and fancy demos.

A demo can prove that a technology works. It cannot prove that an organization has changed.
